model.name: LTX-2 2.5 MSR Ref Distilled 22B
model.description: LTX-2.5 distilled checkpoint (22B) with LiconStudio Multiple Subject Reference V1. Provide 1 to 4 subjects or objects, or 2 to 5 references with the background first. Describe the subjects, their actions, and the role of each reference in the prompt.

prompt: A cinematic tracking shot of the subjects from the reference images walking together in the referenced environment. Preserve each subject's identity and clothing. Natural movement, realistic lighting, and quiet ambient sound.
